messages:
Sam: NovaQBR flag: credits low after embedding spike. Need 30d forecast, quick mitigations, and two customer asks (top-up vs throttle+workshop). Elaine, can you run a short forecast? Tess, any immediate throttle suggestion? Marta, can you prep a 30-45m optimization session? Jordan, standby for promo-credit escalation.

Elaeline: Running a 30d lookup now. Will post baseline + -15% and -30% scenarios and convert tokens->credits->USD. ETA 25m.

Tess: Quick mitigation: soft embeddings RPM cap for 72h (60->40), enable client batching snippet, and add prefix cache for repeated contexts. Draft throttle config: max_rpm:40, duration:72h, rollback_on:errors>0.5%.

Marta: I'll own the session. Agenda: 5m intro, 15m usage triage, 20m live batching/cache tweaks. Deliverable: 1-page ops playbook + PR template. EOD prep.

Jordan: If forecast <14d I can escalate for a 1-month top-up. If 14-30d, offer a 2-week discretionary buffer.

Sam: Thanks. Elaine, post CSV/graph and I'll assemble the QBR addendum. Keep it lean and customer-friendly to avoid renewal friction.
